name: Cyberpunk Web
summary: A wet, neon city at night: dark ground, magenta, cyan and yellow signs, glitch, scan lines, grime, dense HUD panels and kanji or code on every edge. High tech with low life.

philosophy.core_thesis: The future is crowded, dirty and bright: neon on dark, data everywhere.
design_principles: Set the ground in near-black blue (#0A0B14) and light it with neon in magenta (#FF2E88), cyan (#19E3F5) and a yellow warning (#FFE600).
Use glow: a text-shadow or box-shadow of 0 0 12px to 24px in the neon hue at 60% to 80% opacity.
Add scan lines (2px lines at 6% to 10% opacity), noise at 6% and a glitch offset of 2px to 6px in magenta and cyan on headings.
Cut panels at corners (a 12px to 24px chamfer) and frame them with a 1px neon line and small tick marks.
Fill edges with HUD detail: coordinates, serial numbers, barcodes, warning stripes and small mixed-script labels at 10px to 12px.
Set headlines in a hard, wide or condensed upper-case face and body text in a mono at 14px to 16px with 7:1 contrast.
Animate with flicker, glitch and typing: 80ms to 240ms steps; a hover flicker of 3 frames.
anti_patterns: Clean, empty layouts with no grime
Text in neon on neon with low contrast
Neon in more than 3 hues at once

layout.grid_mechanics: A dense, modular layout of 12 columns; HUD panels, rails and ticker bars; headings overlap panels; edges carry small data.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 15% to 30% of the surface is empty; gaps are 8px to 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left mono text; headings may tilt by -2° to +2° or sit on a skew; edges align to small tick marks.
layout.container_geometry: Chamfered rectangles; 1px neon frames; hazard stripes; no round corners above 2px.

font_pairings.note: A wide, hard display with a technical mono.
A tight technical sans with a clean mono.
A cut-corner display that matches chamfered panels.

hierarchy_rules: Use weights 600 to 700 for display and 400 for body.
Set headlines and labels in upper case.
Set data in the mono with tabular figures.

color.palette_structure: Night black with neon magenta, cyan and warning yellow.
color.contrast_rules: Bone on night holds 16:1; black text on magenta holds 6:1; use neon for lines, glow and large marks.
color.surface_treatment: Dark ground with a vertical gradient to #141626; scan lines and noise at 6% to 10%.
color.light_and_shadow: Neon glow of 12px to 24px in the hue; a faint reflection on a wet floor; hard dark shadows.

materiality.surface_simulation: A wet, dark street: glass, metal, neon tubes and grime.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px neon line with chamfered corners and tick marks.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A neon glow instead of a shadow; no blur on text; reflections at 10% on lower edges.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Sharp 1.5px outline icons with square caps; barcodes, kanji, arrows, hazard stripes and warning triangles.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Rain-lit city scenes, signs, cyborg parts, towers and holograms in magenta and cyan.

motion.transition_physics: Electric: flicker, glitch and type-in in hard steps; panels slide 12px; no soft spring.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover flickers the neon for 3 frames and raises the glow by 40%; active state inverts the fill in 80ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels thrill, tension and the pull of a risky city.

avoid_when: The audience is children or needs a gentle tone.
The page is a bank, a clinic or a care service.
The content is a long text that people must read in comfort.

modifiers.how: Keep the dark ground and one accent; remove scan lines, glitch and grime.
Add a sun, a grid horizon and gradients in purple and pink.
Use one green mono face and a character grid.

pack.why: A sharp, pixel-edged family that suits chamfered panels and HUD marks.

ground.why: Cyberpunk takes the neon grid floor and the city sky from eighties film posters.
